requirements: Root supplies actual complete inventories, not this placeholder schema. Every supplied pin is checked against actual bytes before bank writes.

No filename/suffix filter discards material; ordinary phase snapshots all current landing files. Full seeds and every payload-freeze file are external regardless of suffix/size; other landing files >=2000000bytes are external. Original sources remain complete and rechecked.

Additional finished reproduction, staging-tool/review and whitespace-tool/review trees require explicit records for every file in their real frozen inventory. Bank readable small reports/proofs/freezes; retain complete large sources/fixtures/executions externally with pins. Root must independently verify inventory completeness against each tree freeze; this candidate does not silently infer or glob unknown extra trees.

Include the ordinary banking run’s external command/stdin/stdout/stderr/exit, result/input-pins/write-events/head-command files in the final extra inventory. Include all failures and superseded attempts, not only successful summaries.

Final whitespace list must be nonempty and contain actual complete tool/proof/review/command/stream evidence selected after real warnings exist. The candidate validates supplied byte pins only and invents no whitespace-classification schema or approval. Root adaptation/review may be needed once real artifacts exist.

boundaries: Phaseordinary requires no existing landing-proof directory or before/final manifest; both manifests are created only after preflight and exact copy rereads.

Phasefinal verifies the ordinary manifest and every retained original/copy first, adds newly completed landing files and explicit later evidence, and creates a fresh final manifest. It does not edit the ordinary manifest.

Each phase covers its enumerated pre-existing inputs. Its own new manifest and later caller outputs cannot be source records of that same manifest. Later evidence must be captured in a later explicit boundary.

No automatic retry after a partial write: fresh guards fail closed. Preserve run-output failure/write-events and all partially written bytes; root must inspect and explicitly arrange a new reviewed boundary.
prerequisites: Independent root tooling review and explicit invocation; this preparation is not permission to bank.
Actual root pre-staging untracked command capture and exact explicit extra input inventories.
Completed separate isolated reproduction tree may be added once frozen, with its invocation roles clearly separate from the live batch counts.
Final-whitespace phase must await actual staged warnings, separately reviewed whitespace tooling/proofs and complete explicit inventories.
Staging v1 remains exact and unadopted; another reviewer returned NEEDS_CORRECTION and root will separately dispatch v2. No staging file was edited during this task.
